# ArSee · Open-Source IEC 60870-5-101/103/104 Protocol Tester & Analyzer

Free Apache-2.0 Windows IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 60870-5-104 tester and evidence analyzer. Inspect original TX/RX frames, supported values/events, findings and native PDF reports. Not a production SCADA or certified IEC conformance suite.

## Published builds
- Latest public stable v3.6.17: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/tag/v3.6.17
- Stable Windows installer: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/download/v3.6.17/ARIEC60870-v3.6.17-setup-win-x64.exe
- Stable Windows portable ZIP: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/download/v3.6.17/ARIEC60870-v3.6.17-win-x64.zip
- Stable SHA-256: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/download/v3.6.17/SHA256SUMS.txt
- Previous stable v3.6.16: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/tag/v3.6.16
- Archived public prerelease v3.6.17-rc.7: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/releases/tag/v3.6.17-rc.7
- Exact-source stable Package/provenance: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/actions/runs/44540333243
- Native Windows independent updater FAT: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/actions/runs/44539045530
- Historical IEC-101 draft #145 remains unmerged; physical RTU/SCADA FAT is separate.

## Stable v3.6.17 improvements (published 19 November 2026)
- FC10 and FC11 Events tooltips are concise: “Class 1 Data Polling” and “Class 2 Data Polling” for verified observed IEC-101 polls.
- Latest Event auto-follow button highlights only when following, including scroll and selection changes.
- Bilingual Help Center and IEC 60870 handbook, Signal Map grid-first editor, full Windows installer/ZIP with SPDX SBOM.
- Source-bound stable 3.6.17 Windows Package: https://github.com/masarray/arsee/actions/runs/44540333243
- Actual RTU/SCADA field FAT and physical Windows DPI 125/150% are unverified. Stable software is not physical IEC/SCADA conformance certification.

## Previous stable v3.6.16 improvements
- Grid-first Signal Map with CA/IOA, signal, bay, TYPE and mnemonic find/filter and an optional resizable engineering inspector.
- Excel-like atomic multi-cell paste, Fill Down, Undo/Redo and four frozen identity columns; Factor/TwoPoint parameters remain available for measured analogs.
- Actual WPF viewport acceptance checks every TwoPoint input, signed TI11 raw-count warnings and navigation without profile mutation.
- v3.6.14 analog decoder/scaling engine, 31-point source names and opt-in Safe Sync 31 I/O remain unchanged. Real TI11 counts-to-MVar conversion requires authorized gateway calibration (#243).

## Evidence boundary
An addressed link response is not always an accepted application ASDU. GI is not proof every point was received. HOLD pins only the displayed viewport, not recording. Unverified IEC-101 balanced mode or physical multi-vendor FAT must not be claimed.
